markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (64%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (30%) stays in the 90% set [F1], with simulated margins flagged [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 64%, InSitu 30%, Invasive 5% | Favors benign; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target, n=132) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% / 58th percentile [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign, 1/5 InSitu (80%) [F5] | Mostly benign; InSitu contrast exists |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.245 (contribution -0.742) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.071 (contribution -0.421), 0/20 spot check, unreliable [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.055 (contribution -0.234) favors benign glands [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.255 (contribution -0.214) suggests duct-bound atypia · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops risk above random (CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 0 (96%), 8 (67%), or 1 (44%) harbor InSitu (BACH_0057 contrast: pleomorphism, unreliable normal_lobules).
- Deeper levels reveal atypia or InSitu at involved superior, inferior, or medial margins (430 um).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8, 1**: Inspect high-risk tiles (96%, 67%, 44%) at superior, inferior, and medial margins for invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 9**: Check duct-confined atypia (1.13, 1.83) to exclude InSitu; deeper levels are drafted.
3. **Regions 3, 10**: Confirm tubule formation (1.10, 1.47); stains are blocked on simulated frozen sections.
